cluster.kubectl_note: the Kubernetes client built into oc, invoked as kubectl

entries.cmd: kubectl create deployment web --image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/httpd-24:latest --replicas=2 >/dev/null; kubectl rollout status deployment/web --timeout=180s >/dev/null; kubectl get replicasets

entries.cmd: rs=$(kubectl get rs -l app=web -o name); kubectl scale $rs --replicas=5; sleep 5; kubectl get replicasets

entries.cmd: kubectl scale deployment web --replicas=3; sleep 5; kubectl get deployment web; kubectl get replicasets

entries.cmd: pod=$(kubectl get pods -l app=web --no-headers | awk '$3=="Running"{print "pod/"$1; exit}'); kubectl label $pod app=debug --overwrite; sleep 5; kubectl get pods -L app | grep -v Terminating; echo "owner of the debug pod: [$(kubectl get pods -l app=debug -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.ownerReferences[0].name}')]"
